<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 52.24 ppm, 43.47 ppm, and 38.60 ppm correspond to carbon atoms in the typical chemical shift range for methyl (CH₃) groups (including O‑CH₃, N‑CH₃, and alkyl CH₃). No other peaks fall in the methyl region. Therefore, the molecule contains three distinct CH₃ groups.</thought>
